meta.az_convention: from north toward east; index k = azimuth k*0.5 deg

terrain.source: NASA LRO LOLA GDR polar DEMs (PDS, imbrium.mit.edu)
terrain.horizon_method: max terrain elevation angle along great circles, exact 3-D sphere geometry (curvature included); 40 m steps to 20 km, 80 m steps beyond; rays stop where the DEMs end (about 80S)

meta.si_use: Code written with Claude Code (SI) during the event; terrain is NASA LOLA.
